content.title: Consult summary: chest tightness
content.body: You described chest tightness after climbing stairs. The pulse scan estimated 128/84 mmHg and a heart rate of about 72 bpm. Normal sits below 120 over 80. This is a screening signal and not a diagnosis. Please see a doctor within 7 days to confirm with a cuff.
recommendations: Book a clinic visit within 7 days.
